messages:
Arjun R: Quick sync — proposing a tiny, opt-in header shim so console can attribute routed traffic during the routing header rollout. Non-breaking, no raw tenant in logs.

Nora L: Sounds good. What's the exact header format you want? Keep it short for browser clients.

Arjun R: compact suggestion:

X-RW-ROUTE: svc=payments;rh=0x3b
X-RW-META: q=default;t=sha256:7a4f3c

where t is a salted+truncated sha256 of tenant id (console manages salt). Emit only if client opts in.

Theo M: I'll add a client.enable_routing_shim flag to the TS SDK (default off). Also add a unit test ensuring headers are redacted in error logs.

Sam T: Go SDK will match. Important: streaming should not block on hash computation; compute synchronously and keep it tiny (truncate).

Nora L: console will accept both legacy routehint and rwv1 for 30 days; we'll store the hash as tenant_h and never show raw tenant. Add a migration tile showing header_version=legacy|rwv1.

Arjun R: ops checklist: redaction util in SDKs, small migration playbook (<1 page), obs alert for any cleartext tenant, canary at 1% then scale.

sdk-bot: created RW-6800 "rwv1 header shim: SDK flags + console mapping" and linked owners.

Theo M: I'll open PR for TS tomorrow with tests + changelog blurb.

Sam T: will do Go PR after Theo. Keep the opt-in flag so customers can test.

Arjun R: thanks — tag me on PRs and @Nora for console mapping changes. If any cleartext tenant appears in traces, abort the rollout. :rotating_light:
